title: Struktura DFA
description: Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (DFA) anomaly detector. Each channel is scored independently: the DFA scaling exponent is computed on sliding windows and a window is flagged when its robust z-score against a self-calibrated baseline (median + MAD) exceeds a threshold. Outputs one 0/1 column per channel. Zero training, deterministic. Based on Peng et al., Phys. Rev. E, 1994.

parameters.name: window_size
parameters.description: Number of samples per DFA window. Must be >= 64.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Step size between consecutive windows in samples.

parameters.name: baseline_fraction
parameters.description: Fraction of the series (from the start) used to establish the baseline alpha. The rest is scored against it.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: A window is flagged when |alpha - baseline median| / (1.4826 * MAD) exceeds this value.

parameters.name: causal
parameters.description: false (default): flag the whole window, which marks up to window_size samples before the data that triggered it (offline localisation). true: flag only the stride samples after the window ends (online, no look-ahead).

parameters.name: random_state
parameters.description: Not used (deterministic algorithm). Present for framework compatibility.
